name: Maria
source: Maria is the protagonist's girlfriend. Because she wanted to get married after 6 months in their relationship, the protagonist went on a cruise to think about Maria's choice. According to the protagonist, she has a nice smile that could lighten up the whole room, a total sweetheart, and any man would be lucky to have her.
